MRI Safety Information
The Zephyr Vascular Stent System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 4,000 G/cm.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Integrated Whole Body Transmit Coil.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- B1+rms <= 3.6 uT.
- whole-body averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg or less.
- Scan for up to 15 minutes.
- A cooling period of 5 minutes is required between scans.
3 T scanning conditions:
- WB-SAR ≤ 1 W/kg.
- No more than 15 minutes of active scan time per session.
The image artifact extends approximately 2 mm from the device.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
